A burst opened a dozen connections at once"}],"next_checks":["Confirm the current ndots setting in the orders‑api Deployment","Monitor DNS packet loss rates for the cluster DNS service","Evaluate increasing UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE beyond 4 threads","Check if other services with custom ndots exhibit similar latency spikes"]}
